record.reason: 要旨: Data-driven materials development requires the collection of large amounts of high-quality materials data. Full autonomy of materials experiments is anticipated, but its technical hurdles are high and its adoption remains limited. In this study, we constructed a simple, easy-to-deploy automated experimentation。要旨上の主題は対象契約のLLM inference/serving効率、推論時圧縮に該当しない。
record.title: Quantitative control and recording of materials-synthesis processes using an automated experimentation platform
